blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang has ordered the suspension of work in government offices starting at 1 p.m. on Sept. 28 (Monday) to give government employees and their families an opportunity to observe the 34th National Family Week. The Presidential Communications Office (PCO) made the announcement on Thursday. Included are all government agencies and instrumentalities under the Executive branch, as well as government-owned or -controlled corporations and state universities and colleges. The declaration is based on Memorandum Circular No. 136, which is yet to be uploaded at the Official Gazette. “Government workers in the Executive branch are encouraged to fully support the programs […]...
